convert_bundler_to_ply: run the bundler_to_ply script to convert a Bundler reconstruction file to a PLY point cloud
parse_args_bundler_to_ply: parse command line arguments for the bundler_to_ply conversion script with bundler_path and ply_path
normalize_point_cloud: run the bundler_to_ply script with normalization enabled to scale and center the point cloud
filter_by_track_length: run the bundler_to_ply script with min_track_length to filter out sparse 3D points
review_bundler_to_ply_main: review the main function that reads Bundler files, filters points, normalizes coordinates, and writes PLY output
